title: Nice Thanksgiving/Fall Decor
text: Nice Thanksgiving/Fall Decor. This is a nice set of Thanksgiving/Fall decor. It's a good size for my tiered tray. The wood blocks look mass produced (a little too perfect), but they're still fine. I like that this comes with some other items such as the beads, gnome, & leaves.
